default.$description: Text on white, gray, and gold surfaces.

background.$description: Fills behind page and section content.

default.$description: Link on white and gray surfaces.

accent.$description: Decorative emphasis. Draw one item out of a set. Do not use accent color to convey status or as the only cue to meaning.

categorical.$description: Colors for graphical marks on white or black surfaces, one per categorical series. Assign token 1 to the first series, token 2 to the second, and continue in numerical order without skipping or reordering. Use labels or patterns so color is not the only cue.

default.$description: Border on white, gray, and gold surfaces.

strong.$description: Dark border for controls on white, gray, and gold surfaces.

strong-inverse.$description: Light border for controls on black surfaces or with black fills.

info-surface.$description: Fill behind an info message. Pair with info as the border.

success-surface.$description: Fill behind a success message. Pair with success as the border.

warning-surface.$description: Fill behind a warning message. Pair with warning as the border.

danger-surface.$description: Fill behind an error message. Pair with danger as the border.
